_comment: Demo representatives, claims and promises. Every name carries a [DEMO] prefix that renders everywhere the name appears; every citation is titled so the marker shows next to the figure itself. Verification statuses are mixed on purpose so that the fact-check queue, the disputed-claim display and the publish gate all have something to demonstrate.

representatives._note: Carries a DISPUTED claim, so the disputed-badge rendering and the reviewer's public note both have something to show.

claims.review_note: DEMO: The figure declared in the affidavit is contested. A correction filed in March cites a court order stating one of the two matters was closed in 2023. Under review with the Legal Team; the original figure stays visible while that is resolved.

representatives._note: Deliberately left UNPUBLISHED with unverified high-risk claims, so the fact-check queue has real work in it and the publish gate can be demonstrated refusing.

promises.title: 24-hour piped water supply across the constituency within three years
promises.promise_text: DEMO: We will complete the trunk main and ward-level distribution work needed to give every household in the constituency a 24-hour piped supply within three years of taking office.
promises.status_note: DEMO: Phase one covering four wards was commissioned in March. The remaining nine wards are at tender stage per the water board's published progress report.

promises.title: A functioning primary health centre in every block
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Every block in the constituency will have a primary health centre staffed with at least one full-time medical officer.
promises.status_note: DEMO: Six of nine blocks now have a full-time medical officer in post. Three remain vacant, per the district health office's staffing return.

promises.title: Resurface all ward roads before the monsoon
promises.promise_text: DEMO: All ward roads in the constituency will be resurfaced before the monsoon sets in.
promises.status_note: DEMO: The municipal works department's own completion report records 11 of 42 stretches resurfaced by the deadline. No revised timetable has been published.

promises.title: Working toilets in every government school
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Every government school in the constituency will have functioning, separate toilet blocks with a running water connection by the end of the academic year.
promises.status_note: DEMO: The education department's inspection report records all 23 schools compliant as of the September inspection round.

promises.title: Street lighting on every arterial road
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Working street lighting will be installed and maintained on every arterial road in the constituency.
promises.status_note: DEMO: The tender was floated in August 2024 and cancelled in January 2025. No replacement tender has been issued, per the corporation's own tender portal.

promises.title: Support a Right to Recall Bill in the Assembly
promises.made_context: Written reply to a citizen representation
promises.promise_text: DEMO: I will support the introduction of a Bill providing for the recall of members of this Assembly, subject to safeguards on the signature threshold and independent verification.
promises.status_note: DEMO: A private member's Bill has been notified for introduction. Committee stage not yet reached.

promises.title: Four new bus routes connecting outer wards
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Four new bus routes will be introduced to connect the outer wards to the district headquarters.
promises.status_note: DEMO: The commitment carries no deadline and the transport corporation's route plan for the period has not yet been published. Too early to assess either way.

promises.title: Ration portability working at every fair price shop
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Every fair price shop in the state will have working portability, so a card issued anywhere in India can be used at any shop.
promises.status_note: DEMO: The department's monthly return shows 71% of shops with working devices. Coverage in three districts remains below 40%.

promises.title: Old-age pension credited within 30 days of application
promises.promise_text: DEMO: Every approved old-age pension application will be credited within 30 days of approval.
